{{Quote|We will never replace what we have lost. We can only remember it|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>}}
This '''memorial service''' took place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]] to commemorate [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. It was presided by Alderaan's [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in a large [[Unidentified chamber (Delaya)|chamber]]. Due to the thousands of Alderaan refugees who wanted to participate in the memorial, only six hundred were allowed inside the chamber by drawn lots. A live [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] broadcast was made available to the ones who couldn't attend.<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />

After her speech, Organa encouraged the attendees to put a keepsake of theirs inside an empty capsule which was to be jettisoned to [[the Graveyard]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />
